text:
Alex Chen: Heads up—Red team engagement confirmed for Tue Apr 7. Need to lock scope, remediation owners, and retest SLAs. Can we align on audit/logging and KMS key use?
Priya Patel: Thanks Alex. Scope doc link: https://rwd.link/red-team-scope. Main ask: short-lived exposure testing only, no DB dumps. Who's owning remediation triage?
Jordan (red-team): I'll run an initial 48h discovery window + targeted exploitation. We'll hand over report and findings post-run. No lateral movement to prod unless we get explicit approval.
Mike Ortega: I'll own triage and create JIRA tickets. Will need quick access to audit logs for the window—what retention and granularity can we pull?
Sarah Li: Logs are available via Console -> Observability. Default retention 30d; we can export full events for the pen test window. For live access I can grant read-only RBAC to a Red team role.
Alex Chen: RBAC change request: create role 'redteam/readonly' with access to 'observability:logs:view' and 'compute:instances:read'. @Kate can you approve? :eyes: 
Kate (sec-ops): Approving principle. Need an RFC on temporary role expiry and who can escalate. Suggest 7-day TTL with automatic revocation. Also add MFA requirement for the session.
Priya Patel: For KMS—do we want them to use our keys or generate ephemeral keys? Concerned about CMK usage and audit trails.
Sarah Li: Prefer not to give them access to CMKs. We'll create a temporary service key with restricted decrypt/encrypt and audit enabled. Example ARN:
```
arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11bb22-cc33-44dd-55ee-66778899aabb
```
That key will be scheduled for rotation after the window.
Mike Ortega: I'll log remediation tickets with severity tags and owner. Proposed workflow:
1) Create JIRA SECPEN-<id> for each finding
2) Assign to service owners
3) 5 business day SLA for triage
4) 10 business day SLA for fix PR
5) Retest scheduled once fix merged
Anyone object?
Jordan (red-team): Fine. Also want to confirm retest cadence—prefer retest within 3 business days of fix being ready. Can we automate retest triggers via CI?
Priya Patel: We can. Add a "ret­est/request" tag to the JIRA and our CI will run the red-team smoke tests. Need owners to flag readiness.
sec-bot: Created intake ticket SECPEN-842 and linked to Jira SECPEN-842. (timestamp 1768004410)
Alex Chen: Great. Mike, can you post the ticket template here so we can reuse it?
Mike Ortega: Template pasted:
```
Title: [RedTeam] <short desc>
Severity: P1/P2/P3
Owner: <team>
Steps: <repro steps>
Logs: <S3 link>
Remediation ETA: <date>
Retest: <ci/jira-tag>
```
Priya Patel: Also note: KMS usage and key ID must be included in ticket for audit. We need a proof-of-fix artifact (logs + config diff).
Sarah Li: I'll prepare a short runbook for granting the temporary role + key provisioning. Will post by EOD.
Jordan (red-team): We'll avoid destructive tests. If we find creds or tokens, we will disclose immediately in Slack DM to Alex and Priya before escalation.
Kate (sec-ops): Approving the 7-day TTL. Also suggest logging all temporary elevation actions to audit stream and snapshot IAM policies before/after.
Alex Chen: Perfect. Next steps: Sarah post runbook; Mike create intake template in JIRA and create initial SECPEN issues; Priya coordinate KMS provisioning; Jordan confirm start date. Thanks!
Mike Ortega: Done, created SECPEN-842, SECPEN-843 for scope issues. I'll DM owners. :thumbsup: 
Priya Patel: KMS temp key provisioned (arn above) and rotation scheduled for 2026-04-15. Added key ID to tickets.
Sarah Li: Runbook uploaded: https://rwd.link/pen-test-runbook. Contains RBAC request form and commands to export logs.
Alex Chen: OK closing thread—any follow-ups please reply here. :white_check_mark:
